name: p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 3

function.text: PAK3 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 3. Annotated molecular activities include MAP kinase kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and axonogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked 30 (x-linked).

function.text: PAK3 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 3. Based in part on similarity, it is a serine/threonine protein kinase that plays a role in a variety of different signaling pathways including cytoskeleton regulation, cell migration, or cell cycle regulation. It contributes to dendrite spine morphogenesis as well as synapse formation and plasticity. It functions as a downstream effector of the small GTPases CDC42 and RAC1.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked 30 (x-linked).
